annotations.title: Plan a web app from an idea

description: Turn a plain-English app idea into a build plan: matched use case, page sections, features, a suggested data model, integrations, honest limits, a refined build prompt and a link that opens the GYSM builder with that prompt. Free and instant: it makes no AI call, creates nothing and changes nothing. It is a plan, not a generated app.
